title: DOC: Improving Long Story Coherence With Detailed Outline Control
scope: ACL 2023 paper; hierarchical planning and passage control for several-thousand-word stories; human evaluation.
limitation: Historical GPT-3-era systems; does not establish effectiveness at novel length or with current models.

title: StoryWriter: A Multi-Agent Framework for Long Story Generation
scope: Preprint v1; event outlines, chapter planning, compressed history; human and model evaluation.
limitation: Average evaluated output is 8,081 words; baseline lengths differ substantially; not a full-novel validation.

title: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
scope: Science Advances randomized experiment; GPT-4 idea assistance for human-written eight-sentence stories.
limitation: Microfiction, fixed idea prompts, no iterative collaboration; not evidence about entirely AI-authored novels.

title: Help Me Write a Story: Evaluating LLMs' Ability to Generate Writing Feedback
scope: ACL 2025 paper, read through arXiv v1; 1,300-story feedback benchmark with synthetic problems.
limitation: Short English stories and older model set; measures single-turn feedback, not iterative revision outcomes.

title: Readers Prefer Outputs of AI Trained on Copyrighted Books over Expert Human Writers
scope: Preprint v4; preregistered blinded comparison of up-to-450-word author-emulation excerpts across reader groups.
limitation: Short excerpts, older models, and author-specific fine-tuning; neither a novel-quality test nor a contest-jury proxy.

title: CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories
scope: Preprint v1; feature-guided story revision; cross-editor comparisons and human evaluation.
limitation: Human study has 20 eligible groups; perceived human-likeness and model-derived features do not establish literary merit or novel coherence.
